findings: Cg applies to reference lateral design value Z under NDS11.3.6; no primary support found for treating receiver-tuple1/n as an applicable row Cg.
Existing bearing includes4Ktheta, the ModeI reduction; before-Cg is not raw Fe utilization.
Pointwise affine pressure plus reduced plastic shaft N/M is not demonstrated equivalent to min(all applicable yield modes)Z for these mixed multiport connections.
NDS11.2.3 separates independent metal design and excludes NDS adjustment factors from metal strength.
Unequal modeled individual forces do not automatically waive Cg, but also do not establish that applying1/n to each already-resolved individual demand is the prescribed group check.
NDS11.1.2/11.1.3 and12.6 require member local-stress and eccentric/oblique treatment beyond bolt yield.
